Subject: Office relocation - 18 workstations

Hello,

We are relocating our accounting office from Suite 400, 1200 Main St, Dallas, TX to 55 Commerce Pkwy, Plano, TX. Target is the weekend of December 6-7 so we don't lose a business day. Inventory: 18 desks, 18 task chairs, 6 lateral file cabinets, one conference table with 10 chairs, and a small server rack. The building requires a certificate of insurance and a freight elevator reservation.

Please send a quote.

Dana R., Office Manager
